query: UPDATE net_realms SET ipv4_subnet = coalesce($1, ipv4_subnet), ipv4_nat = coalesce($2, ipv4_nat), ipv6_prefix = coalesce($3, ipv6_prefix), vlan = coalesce($4, vlan), ipv4_router = coalesce($5, ipv4_router), ipv4_dns = coalesce($6, ipv4_dns), ipv4_dhcp_server = coalesce($8, ipv4_dhcp_server) WHERE id = $7
